title: 'Barbie box' prompt as a memory test: ask your AI to draw you as a boxed doll with your accessories and see how little it really remembers (recency bias vs memory)

tools.name: Mistral 'Le Chaton Fat' model
tools.detail: Mistral release that day; the AI named his dog after it, showing recency bias

tools.name: Barbie-box image prompt
tools.detail: 'make a Barbie box showing you with all your assets, accessories, family, dog'

claims: The model got his dog wrong (not a Corgi) despite that being widely known about him
It named the dog 'le chaton fat' after a Mistral model released that day: 'That is recency bias. That is not memory. That is not AGI.'
The Barbie-box prompt is a quick diagnostic of what an assistant remembers about you
how_to_steps: Prompt your AI (with memory on): 'make a Barbie box showing me with all my assets and accessories, my family, my dog'
Inspect what it got right/wrong to see what memory actually holds vs recent-chat bias
Post the image in the comments
on_screen_only: Caption banner: 'AI Hack: Ask AI To Make Your Barbie Box'
cta: share your Barbie box image in the comments

relevance.why: Fun memory diagnostic; mildly useful as a reminder that chat memory is shallow and recency-biased, but no founder workflow

implement_score.why: Two-minute novelty; the only takeaway (don't trust assistant memory, keep facts in files) is already covered

verify: Nothing to verify beyond the existence of the Mistral release he references

gap.what: duplicate of liked content theme (memory is unreliable); novelty prompt only
